name: 윤곽 연속성 분석
algorithm: Contour Continuity — 픽셀 수준 공간 분석
mechanism:
This method analyzes facial contour continuity for deepfake detection following Li et al. (2020) Face X-ray:

1. **Facial윤곽추출**: The complete facial contour — forehead hairline, temple, cheekbone, jawline, chin — is traced per frame using high-resolution edge detection and facial landmark interpolation. The contour is parameterized as a smooth curve with measured curvature at each point.

2. **CurvatureContinuity분석**: Natural facial contours are C² continuous (smooth second derivative) except at anatomical feature boundaries (chin point, jaw angle). The method detects breaks in curvature continuity — deepfake face swaps may produce contour kinks or unnaturally straight segments where the generated face mesh interfaces with the original face boundary.

3. **윤곽-피부경계분석**: Following Li et al.'s Face X-ray approach, the method examines the blending boundary between the face and surrounding area. Authentic faces have seamless continuation from face to neck/hair. Deepfakes create a detectable blending boundary where the generated face patch meets the original footage, visible as subtle texture or color discontinuities along the contour.

4. **시간적윤곽추적**: The facial contour is tracked across frames. Natural contours deform smoothly according to facial muscles and head rotation. Deepfake contours may exhibit temporal jitter — small frame-to-frame fluctuations in contour position inconsistent with smooth physical motion, caused by independent per-frame face generation.

5. **Multi-Scale윤곽점수 산출**: Contour continuity is analyzed at multiple scales: coarse (overall shape), medium (local curvature), and fine (pixel-level edge quality). Natural faces show consistent quality at all scales. Deepfakes may show good coarse continuity but poor fine-scale continuity at blending boundaries, yielding a graded forensic score.
parameters:
분석 유형: 픽셀
미디어: 비디오
입력: Video frames extracted at key intervals
출력: 신뢰도 점수 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 중간~높음 — 70-88% 단독 정확도. Most effective when combined with other 비디오 forensic methods. Performance depends on 비디오 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 비디오 through contour continuity analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 비디오 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 비디오 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 비디오 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 비디오 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 비디오
